reviews.fullText: Anatoli's work ethic, communication skills and technical competence are superb. Not only did he reach all of the milestones of the project in a timely manner, but also he communicated with the client, analyzed requirements, developed the product and did that with excellent quality. He also suggested better solutions than those we initially came up with. Anatoli is a true software craftsman. Would hire again, 10/10. Thank you, Anatoli!
